name: Grilled Angus Strip Loin Steak with Cheddar Smashed Potatoes (Let the Magic Begin)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Let the Magic Begin Menu
whyItWorks: Grilled strip loin steak is high in iron and zero-fiber; ask for plain mashed or baked potatoes to avoid onions in the cheddar smash.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the strip loin medium-rare with plain baked or mashed potatoes (the standard cheddar smashed potatoes contain diced onions) and skip the grilled tomato.
watchOuts: Onions mixed into standard cheddar smashed potatoes (swap for plain potato)
